beats.text: You can zoom onto this airfield. The CIA confirmed it in two thousand thirteen.
What were they guarding for fifty-eight years?
Its official name is Homey Airport.
Its research is Top Secret, and UFO folklore grew around it.
Cameras keep an eye on the road in.
In nineteen fifty-five, the CIA and Air Force came to test the U-2 spy plane.
It's still thought to test experimental aircraft and weapons.
Officially, the Air Force calls it an open training range.
Next target: a lake that stays pink even in a container. Follow for the next scan. Orbi out.

draft.description: Area 51 is a highly classified US Air Force facility in southern Nevada, officially called Homey Airport or Groom Lake. The USAF and CIA acquired it in 1955 mainly for Lockheed U-2 flight tests, and the CIA publicly acknowledged it in 2013.
